overview: Copie Past-e is a SaaS web app for archiving, reusing, and posting marketplace listings. It features Smart Paste and Smart Photo OCR for fast import, a retro-futuristic BTTF-themed UI, tiered subscriptions, Stripe payments, and a comprehensive admin panel with debugger, backup, and support tools.
features: Smart Photo OCR with Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
Smart Post to Facebook Marketplace via Chrome extension
Adaptive Auto Backup by site size
Export All Users with named folders ZIP
